title: Roles and composite roles
subtitle: VIEW, MANAGE, TC_ADMIN, TC_AUDITOR and the service roles
summary: Each module has a VIEW and a MANAGE realm role; MANAGE is a composite that contains VIEW. TC_ADMIN is a composite of every MANAGE role and TC_AUDITOR of every VIEW role. Service accounts carry SVC_READ and, for modules that post accounting events, SVC_GL_POST.

sections.title: The convention
items: CORE_VIEW … TREASURY_VIEW: open every GET page of the module.
CORE_MANAGE … TREASURY_MANAGE: everything VIEW allows plus every state-changing request (POST).
TC_ADMIN: composite of all MANAGE roles; also reopens closed GL periods and approves as the second user.
TC_AUDITOR: composite of all VIEW roles; opens the audit trail and TurfBot's audit tools.
SVC_READ: a service may GET any /api/** endpoint.
SVC_GL_POST: a service may post accounting events to the GL.

sections.title: Test users
rows: Audit trail, read-only checks, TurfBot audit questions

sections.title: How composites expand
sections.diagram:
flowchart LR
  ADMIN[TC_ADMIN] --> CM[CORE_MANAGE]
  ADMIN --> GM[GL_MANAGE]
  ADMIN --> RM[RACING_MANAGE]
  ADMIN --> X[... every MANAGE]
  CM --> CV[CORE_VIEW]
  GM --> GV[GL_VIEW]
  RM --> RV[RACING_VIEW]
  AUD[TC_AUDITOR] --> CV
  AUD --> GV
  AUD --> RV
  AUD --> Y[... every VIEW]

sections.title: Where roles are checked
paragraphs: Module UIs: the web filter chain requires <MODULE>_VIEW for GET and <MODULE>_MANAGE for every other method, so a read-only user cannot submit any form even by crafting a request.
APIs: GET /api/** needs SVC_READ or the module's VIEW role; writes are guarded per endpoint with @PreAuthorize, for example hasAnyRole('SVC_GL_POST','GL_MANAGE') on the accounting-event endpoint.
Templates: buttons for MANAGE actions are only rendered for MANAGE users (Thymeleaf security dialect).
TurfBot: the same role names decide which tools Claude is given.
